title: Ice Spice Son
blurb: One syllable, delivered with the bored authority of somebody who settled the exchange several sentences ago. What makes the clip so reusable is the complete absence of effort in it — no raised voice, no argument, no attempt to persuade anybody of anything, just a word that quietly reorganises the hierarchy of the conversation. It became a go-to reaction for putting somebody in their place at minimum cost. Deploy it when a reply would dignify the point, and you have decided the point does not merit dignifying.
origin: A viral Ice Spice interview moment adopted as a dismissal.
